_comment: Hg T2 overlay R1B = RECOMMENDED set (2026-11-26; WORK_NOTES_hg_t2 sections 21-22): S5F + re-emission fix R light term only: hg_t2_ev_light 1, hg_ev_wl 1.0 (hg_ev_tauref 1 default), hg_fd 0.223. Soil-air (hg_t2_ev_air) and temperature (hg_ev_q10) terms stay off. Needs a binary with commit 0096a403 or later. Scoring: Toolik Ro, Hg:DOC, net Hg(0) and winter share are report-only (Toolik C recalibration pending). model_settings overlay on top of the built-in hg_t2 preset and the MeHg preset; code defaults unchanged (all R switches off).
_site_keys: Per-site keys not in the overlay (set by the case): hg_dep_file (TVC / HPC: config/hg_deposition_{tvc,hpc}_geoschem.csv; Toolik: config/hg_deposition_toolik_obrist2017.csv), hg_sc_year0 (1850 spin-up stage / 1950 main, TVC / HPC). Run with dynamic_lai 1.
